title: Integration: Insert Table -> Edit Cell -> Apply Bold -> Save -> Reload
description: Validates complete lifecycle across Table, Writing, Save, and Persistence components.

steps.description: Insert 2x2 table into document
Type 'Revenue' in Cell (1,1) and apply Bold via Ctrl+B
Click Save in EditorHeader
Reload application
Verify reloaded document contains 2x2 table with bold 'Revenue' in Cell (1,1)

title: Integration: Apply Style -> Edit Text -> Undo -> Redo
description: Validates interoperability between Styles engine and Undo/Redo stack.

steps.description: Apply Heading 1 style to paragraph
Type ' Revised'
Press Ctrl+Z twice
Verify text and style revert sequentially
Press Ctrl+Y twice
Verify text and Heading 1 style are restored

title: Integration: Enable Track Changes -> Edit Text -> Accept Change -> Save
description: Validates Track Changes workflow successfully commits revision and persists clean state.

steps.description: Enable Track Changes in Review ribbon
Type 'Reviewed audit notes'
Click 'Accept' in Review ribbon
Click Save button in header
Verify document saves with accepted clean text and zero pending changes

title: Integration: Enable Track Changes -> Edit Text -> Reject Change -> Save
description: Validates rejecting tracked revision discards text and saves unmodified document.

steps.description: Enable Track Changes and insert text 'Discarded text'
Click 'Reject' button
Click Save button
Verify 'Discarded text' is omitted from saved document

title: Integration: Insert Figure -> Add Caption -> Move Position -> Save -> Reload
description: Validates Figures module persistence including caption and positioning coordinates.

steps.description: Insert Chart figure with caption 'Figure 1'
Click Save button
Reload application
Verify Chart rehydrates in exact position with 'Figure 1' caption

title: Integration: Layout Margins Change -> Insert Table -> Verify Table Width fits Margins
description: Validates table insertion honors custom document margins without overflowing printable area.

steps.description: Set Margins to 'Wide' (2 inch left/right)
Insert 3x3 table
Verify table width matches the reduced content width constraint

title: Integration: Multi-page Document -> Insert Page Break -> Insert Page Numbers -> Check Pagination
description: Validates Document overflow engine, Page Break, and dynamic Header/Footer page numbering.

steps.description: Insert manual page break creating Page 2
Insert Page Numbers at Bottom Center
Verify Page 1 displays '1' and Page 2 displays '2'

title: Integration: Table Insertion -> Track Changes -> Delete Table Row -> Verify Tracked Deletion
description: Validates Track Changes correctly handles table structural edits.

steps.description: Insert table with 3 rows
Enable Track Changes
Delete Row 2
Verify row deletion is registered as tracked revision

title: Regression: Table Insertion does not disrupt Text Editing outside table
description: REGRESSION: Validates inserting a table leaves preceding and succeeding text paragraphs completely editable.

steps.description: Type Paragraph 1, insert table, type Paragraph 2
Edit text in Paragraph 1
Verify Paragraph 1 accepts text input normally without table intercepting keystrokes

title: Regression: Figure Insertion does not break Table functionality
description: REGRESSION: Validates adding a figure on the same page as a table does not freeze table cell editing.

steps.description: Insert table and insert shape figure on same page
Click inside table cell and type text
Verify cell typing functions normally

title: Regression: Text formatting does not corrupt Document pagination model
description: REGRESSION: Validates applying bold or heading styles dynamically recomputes pagination heights without crashing.

steps.description: Apply Heading 1 style (larger font height)
Verify pagination model recalculates page boundaries cleanly

title: Regression: Undo does not remove unrelated sibling content
description: REGRESSION: Validates undoing an edit in Paragraph 2 does not inadvertently erase Paragraph 1.

steps.description: Type Paragraph 1, then type Paragraph 2
Undo edit in Paragraph 2
Verify Paragraph 1 remains completely intact

title: Regression: Theme Toggle (Dark / Light) does not alter document content or state
description: REGRESSION: Validates toggling theme between light and dark updates CSS variables without modifying document model.

steps.description: Click ThemeToggle in editor header
Verify dark class is toggled on html root
Verify document text content and active page number remain unchanged

title: Regression: Rapid panel switching (Writing -> Tables -> Figures -> Styles)
description: REGRESSION: Validates rapid switching between sidebar modules does not cause memory leaks or UI unmount crashes.

steps.description: Click Writing, then Tables, then Figures, then Styles icons in rapid succession
Verify final panel (Styles) mounts cleanly with zero uncaught runtime exceptions

title: Integration: Save As new document -> Switch to Dashboard -> Verify document list
description: Validates saved document is registered in user document index.

steps.description: Save document as 'Q3_Final_Release'
Verify document is indexed with updated timestamp

title: Integration: Bare Links Convertor -> Undo conversion -> Verify original text restored
description: Validates Bare Links automated anchor conversion can be cleanly reversed via Undo.

steps.description: Type 'https://sample.com' and click 'Convert Bare Links'
Press Ctrl+Z
Verify live anchor converts back to plain text URL string

title: Integration: Table Column deletion -> Undo -> Verify table geometry and content restored
description: Validates complex table undo correctly reconstructs multidimensional cell array.

steps.description: Delete Column 2 from 3x3 populated table
Click Undo
Verify Column 2 is restored with exact cell text across all 3 rows

title: Integration: Custom Watermark + Landscape Orientation + Table -> Print Preview
description: Validates Print stylesheet accurately prints document containing watermark, custom orientation, and table.

steps.description: Set Landscape, add 'CONFIDENTIAL' watermark, and insert table
Click Print in header
Verify print preview includes landscape layout, watermark layer, and table

title: Regression: Deleting text across multiple pages cleanly coalesces pages
description: REGRESSION: Validates selecting text spanning from Page 1 into Page 2 and deleting removes Page 2 when empty.

steps.description: Select cross-page text range across Page 1 and Page 2 boundary and press Delete
Verify text is deleted and pagination engine collapses trailing empty page

title: Integration: Full End-to-End Document Workflow (Draft, Format, Insert Table, Figure, Review, Save)
description: Comprehensive end-to-end user journey validating all 10 core components in a single session.

steps.description: Type document introduction and apply Title style
Apply Bold, Italic, and color to key terms via Writing panel
Insert 3x2 table and populate quarterly metrics
Insert Bar Chart figure from Figures module
Set Page Margins to Moderate and insert Page Numbers at Bottom Center
Enable Track Changes, make revision, and Accept change
Click Save in EditorHeader
Verify document saves with 0 errors and all components render consistently
